title: Noah's Ark
lines: Now at this time, Noah pleased God and was the only righteous man living on earth.
那時，挪亞蒙神喜悅，是地上唯一的義人。
He had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
他有三個兒子：閃、含、雅弗。
The earth had become corrupt and was filled with violence.
世界敗壞了，地上滿了強暴。
So God said to Noah, "I have decided to destroy all living creatures, for they have filled the earth with violence."
神就對挪亞說：「我決定要毀滅一切活物，因為地上滿了他們的強暴。」
"Yes, I will wipe them all out with the earth."
He instructed Noah, "Build a large boat from cypress wood and waterproof it with tar inside and out."
祂吩咐挪亞：「你要用歌斐木造一艘大船，裡外抹上松香（瀝青），使它不漏水。」
"Then construct decks and stalls throughout its interior."
「再在裡面建造甲板和一間一間的隔間。」
"Make the boat 450 feet long, 75 feet wide, and 45 feet high."
「船要長 450 呎、寬 75 呎、高 45 呎。」
"Leave an 18-inch opening below the roof all the way around the boat."
「在船頂下方四周留一道 18 吋的透光口。」
"Put the door on the side, and build three decks inside the boat: lower, middle, and upper."
「門要開在旁邊，船內要分上、中、下三層。」
"Look," said the Lord, "I am about to cover the earth with a flood that will destroy every living thing that breathes."
耶和華說：「看哪，我要使洪水氾濫在地上，毀滅一切有氣息的活物。」
"But I will confirm my covenant with you."
"So enter the boat, you and your wife and your sons and their wives."
「你同你的妻，與兒子兒婦，都要進入方舟。」
"Bring a pair of every kind of animal, and be sure to take on board enough food for your family and for all the animals."
「每一種動物都要帶一對，也要帶足夠的食物給你的家人和所有動物。」
Noah obeyed God and built the ark precisely as God had instructed.
挪亞順服神，完全照神的吩咐建造了方舟。
The Lord said to Noah, "Go into the boat with all your family, for among all the people of the earth, I can see that you alone are good."
耶和華對挪亞說：「你和你的全家都要進入方舟，因為在這世代中，我見你在我面前是義人。」
"Take with you the animals I approve."
"Seven days from now I will make the rains pour down on the earth."
"It will rain for forty days and forty nights, until I have wiped from the earth all the living things I have created."
「四十晝夜，把我所造的各種活物都從地上除滅。」
At this time, Noah was six hundred years old.
So Noah entered the boat with his wife and his sons and their wives.
挪亞就同他的妻和兒子兒婦都進入方舟。
Two by two, one pair of every kind of animal came into the boat, representing every living thing that breathes.
各樣的動物一對一對地進入方舟，代表一切有氣息的活物。
Then the Lord closed the door behind them.
耶和華就把他們關在方舟裡。
For forty days the flood waters grew deeper, covering the ground and lifting the boat high above the earth.
洪水氾濫四十天，水勢越漲越深，淹沒地面，把方舟高高托起。
The only people who survived were Noah and those with him in the boat.
只留下挪亞和那些與他同在方舟裡的人。
When the time came, God sent a wind and the rain stopped.
時候到了，神叫風吹地，雨就止住了。
Noah opened a window and released a raven.
挪亞開了窗戶，放出一隻烏鴉。
The bird flew back and forth until the flood waters on the earth had dried up.
那烏鴉飛來飛去，直到地上的水都乾了。
He also released a dove to see if it could find dry ground.
他又放出一隻鴿子，要看看地上是否有乾地。
Noah waited, and the dove returned.
He tried again, and the dove returned to him, this time with a fresh olive leaf in its beak.
他再試一次，鴿子又回到他那裡，這次嘴裡叼著一片新擰下來的橄欖葉。
Noah released the dove again. This time it did not come back.
挪亞又放出鴿子，這次牠不再回來了。
When the earth was dry, God said to Noah, "Leave the boat, all of you."
地都乾了，神對挪亞說：「你們都出方舟吧。」
"Release all the animals so they can be fruitful and multiply throughout the earth."
「把所有動物都放出來，叫牠們在地上多多滋生，大大興旺。」
So Noah, his family, and all the animals followed God's instructions and came out of the ark.
於是挪亞、他的家人和所有動物都照神的吩咐出了方舟。
Noah built an altar to worship the Lord, and this pleased the Lord.
挪亞為耶和華築了一座壇敬拜祂，耶和華就喜悅。
God blessed Noah and his sons and told them, "Be fruitful and multiply. Fill the earth."
神賜福給挪亞和他的兒子，對他們說：「你們要生養眾多，遍滿了地。」
Then God said, "I hereby confirm my covenant with you. Never again will a flood destroy the earth."
神說：「我與你們立約，凡有血肉的，不再被洪水滅絕，也不再有洪水毀壞地了。」
"I am giving you a sign of my covenant by placing my rainbow in the clouds."
「我把虹放在雲彩中，這就是我立約的記號。」
"When I see the rainbow in the clouds, I will remember the eternal covenant between God and every living creature on earth."
「虹必現在雲彩中，我看見，就要記念我與地上各樣有血肉的活物所立的永約。」
